There will be no more night. They will not need the light of the Lamb or the light of the Son, for the Lord God will give them light. And they will reign forever and ever.
And so, with that picture, one chapter of human history ends, and we see what we were
made for, Christ and the church, husband and wife, living in joyful union, at rest from
all of their enemies, ruling over creation for the glory of God.
And who knows what the next chapter holds?
Brothers and sisters, this is the stuff of legends, but know that this is no mere fable.
This is no tall tale.
No, this is the world that we live in.
This is what all of human history is driving at.
Who would have thought that our deepest longings and our happiest dreams were actually pointing
us to Jesus Christ?
As C.S. Lewis writes, if we discover a desire within us that nothing in this world can satisfy,
also we should begin to wonder if perhaps we were created for another world. This fallen world is
not the end. We have a king who has come and has saved us and is coming to save us. Will you
follow him.
King Jesus, you are our King.
It is our joy to honor you.
So provide for all that we need.
As our King, we turn to you, we depend on you.
Bring us safely home, Lord, that we might know some day your full presence dwelling
in our midst, and that we might sit with you and reign with you forever.
O Lord, cause us to persevere, that we might see this reality someday.
We pray this in Christ's name.
